subject: Proposed Exhibit G fee-floor exception & SOW split for Q4 ramp
messages:
From: Erin Quinn <erin.quinn@lumenix.io>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@lumenix.io>, procurement@lumenix.io
Date: Fri, 05 Oct 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Exhibit G + SOW split request for Q4 ramp

Hi Laura —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Lumenix is targeting a Q4 ramp and we need to finalize commercial terms this week. Two asks from procurement/legal: 1) a one-time carve that allows a temporary fee floor reduction on Exhibit G for the first 60 days of ramp (we can provide expected throughput numbers in the attached workbook), and 2) split the SOW into two exhibits so implementation work is decoupled from long-term throughput commitments.

Attached is our internal cost model (Lumenix-cost-model-Q4.xlsx) and a marked-up version of your Exhibit G (we highlighted sections for the fee-floor). Can you confirm whether Redwood can accommodate a temporary fee-floor exception and provide a draft redline for the split SOW? If so we can route for signature by Friday.

Appreciate it —
Erin
Erin Quinn
Head of Procurement, Lumenix
Attachments: Lumenix-cost-model-Q4.xlsx
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Erin Quinn <erin.quinn@lumenix.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Oct 2028 10:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exhibit G + SOW split request for Q4 ramp

Erin —

Thanks for the clear ask and the model. We can scope a 60-day fee-floor relief tied to a minimum throughput ramp schedule, but we need Legal to produce a redline that includes a rollback trigger and clear acceptance criteria for the implementation exhibit. Karthik — can you validate the throughput numbers and suggest an operational rollback (metrics + time window)? Soojin — can Legal produce a focused redline of Exhibit G and a separate Exhibit H (Implementation SOW) that isolates onboarding fees and acceptance criteria?

We're aiming for an internal approval path today and a send-to-signature by Thursday EOD if all parties align. I attached the original Exhibit G for reference.

Best,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Commercial Lead, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | laura.bennett@redwood.com
Attachments: Exhibit-G-draft_v2.docx
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Erin Quinn <erin.quinn@lumenix.io>
Date: Fri, 05 Oct 2028 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exhibit G + SOW split request for Q4 ramp

Laura / Soojin —

Quick notes from scoping: the Lumenix model shows a steep delta in week 3 of ramp (from 250k tokens/day to 1.2M). Operationally, to keep latency & cache efficiency, I'd propose: 1) a staged throughput milestone (30/60/90 days) tied to fee-floor levels; 2) a rollback clause that reverts fee-floor after 60 days if average throughput < 60% of the milestone for any consecutive 14-day window; 3) a shared playbook item for burst management (redispatch to Dedicated tier).

If Legal wants a simpler trigger, we can change the consecutive-window to 21 days — longer windows reduce false triggers. I can draft the implementation acceptance checklist (deploy timeline, perf targets, contact list) and attach as Exhibit H.

LMK and I can produce the operational checklist in the next 2 hours for Legal to fold into the redline.

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Erin Quinn <erin.quinn@lumenix.io>
Date: Mon, 08 Oct 2028 09:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exhibit G + SOW split request for Q4 ramp

Folks —

Attached is Legal's focused redline (Exhibit-G_redline_BY-legal.pdf) and a draft Exhibit H (Implementation SOW language embedded in the redline). Key legal points we added:
- Fee-floor exception limited to 60 calendar days from the Effective Date and conditioned on Lumenix providing weekly throughput reports.
- Rollback trigger: if measured throughput < 60% of the agreed milestone for any 21-day consecutive window, fee-floor resets to standard Exhibit G rates as of the next billing cycle.
- Implementation SOW (Exhibit H) contains acceptance tests (latency p95 <= 450ms at target load, KV hit rate >= 70% for cached prefixes) and a remediation window (14 days) before a mitigation plan is enacted.
- Added a mutual audit right for the 60-day relief period limited to one review.

Operational ask to Commercial: can we commit to the 21-day window above rather than 14? The 21-day window balances operational variance with customer expectations.

If Lumenix agrees, I can produce a clean for signature and prepare a DocuSign envelope.

Soojin Lee
Counsel, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Exhibit-G_redline_BY-legal.pdf, Exhibit-H-draft_SOW.docx
From: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@lumenix.io>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Erin Quinn <erin.quinn@lumenix.io>, procurement@lumenix.io, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Oct 2028 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exhibit G + SOW split request for Q4 ramp

Laura / team —

Thanks for the fast turnaround and the clear redline. Lumenix is willing to accept the 21-day rollback window and the 60-day limited relief, provided we have the implementation acceptance tests in Exhibit H and a single go/no-go checkpoint at day 30 with a short remediation lane.

Next steps: please send the clean Exhibit G + Exhibit H in DocuSign and include the agreed milestone schedule in the envelope. We'll aim to sign within 48 hours after legal review on our side. Also requesting that the DocuSign envelope include the ability to countersign by our VP, Ops (name on file).

Tom Alvarez
VP, Strategic Partnerships, Lumenix
Attachments: none
